leadText:
A Movie Star (Japanese: スター Star) is a type of Pokémon Trainer introduced in Pokémon Black 2 and White 2, appearing exclusively at Pokéstar Studios. They are Gym Leaders who act in movies.

There are two Movie Stars who appear in three different movie series.

Brycen appears as a Movie Star in both the Brycen-Man and Full Metal Cop Series. He plays the role of Masked Man in Brycen-Man - The Riolu Kid vs. Brycen Man (in 's version of the series), Brycen-Man - The Riolu Girl vs. Brycen Man (in 's version of the series), Brycen-Man Strikes Back, and Brycen-Man Strikes Back Harder. He also plays the role of World Police in Full Metal Cop - Enter the Sneasel Ninja!, Full Metal Cop 2 - The Sneasel Ninja's Trap, and Full Metal Cop 4 - The Sneasel Ninja: The Final Case. In the former series, he uses Pokémon during filming. In the latter series, he uses - and Pokémon.

Brycen is also the likeness for , which plays the role of Brycen-Man in Brycen-Man Strikes Back 2.

Sabrina appears as a Movie Star in the Mystery Doors of the Magical Land Series. She plays the roles of Strange Lady in Mystery Doors of the Magical Land - Beyond a Door and Magic Queen in Mystery Doors of the Magical Land 3 - Open a Door. In the former, she uses Pokémon during filming. In the latter, she uses and .

===Pokémon Adventures===
In Movie Panic, it was revealed that Sabrina had become a star actress at the Pokéstar Studios. Using one of her 's Spoons of Destiny, she guided the reluctant to perform in a Brycen-Man movie. During the filming, Whitley played the heroine, while Brycen, who had returned to being a movie actor, played the movie's titular villain.
